nodes.description: Total token supply, set to INITIAL_SUPPLY in the DENtoken constructor.
Global flag gating token transfers; toggled by enableTransfers and required in transfer/transferFrom.
Mapping address => balance of DEN tokens; written by transfer, transferFrom, mint and the constructor.
Nested mapping owner => spender => allowance; written by approve, increaseApproval, decreaseApproval and transferFrom.
Total wei collected during the token sale; increased in buyTokens.
Running total of tokens allocated during the sale; increased in buyTokens.
Contract owner address; controls privileged functions and receives sale proceeds.
Sale activation flag; set true in startSale and false in stopSale.
Constant initial supply of 25,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals.
ERC20 transfer guarded by onlyPayloadSize(2); moves balances[msg.sender] to _to when transfersEnabled.
View returning balances[_owner].
ERC20 transferFrom guarded by onlyPayloadSize(3); moves tokens using the caller allowance.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value; classic approval race condition surface.
View returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Adds _addedValue to the caller allowance with SafeMath.add.
Subtracts _subtractedValue from the caller allowance, clamping at zero.
Constructor: sets totalSupply, owner = msg.sender, funds owner balance, enables transfers.
Payable fallback that forwards msg.sender into buyTokens.
Payable token sale: computes token amount, accrues weiRaised/tokenAllocated, mints and sends ether to owner.
Checks remaining owner balance against requested token amount and returns 0 on limit reached.
Internal pure tiered pricing table mapping wei amounts to token amounts.
Internal mint moving _amount from _owner balance to _to.
onlyOwner function transferring ownership to _newOwner.
onlyOwner function enabling the token sale.
onlyOwner function disabling the token sale.
onlyOwner function toggling the global transfersEnabled flag.
onlyOwner function that sweeps contract ether and remaining token balance to owner.
msg.sender: caller identity used for balances, allowances and ownership checks.
wallet.transfer(weiAmount): external ether send executed at the end of buyTokens.
owner.transfer(this.balance): external ether send inside claimTokens.
Unconditional overwrite of the allowance mapping in approve (front-running friendly).

_weiAmount parameter of getTotalAmountOfTokens.

wallet local in buyTokens, cached from state owner and used for the ether transfer.
weiAmount local in buyTokens, cached from msg.value.
tokens local in buyTokens, result of validPurchaseTokens.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the debit account in transfer.
_to parameter flows into balances[_to] credit inside transfer.
_value parameter flows into the balance subtraction inside transfer.
balances mapping is read for the sender and recipient in transfer.
transfer writes updated balances for sender and recipient.
_owner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
balanceOf returns values read from the balances mapping.
_from parameter is used to debit balances and allowances in transferFrom.
_to parameter is credited inside transferFrom.
_value parameter drives the balance and allowance subtractions in transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
the allowed mapping is read and validated in transferFrom.
the balances mapping is read for _from and _to in transferFrom.
transferFrom writes debited and credited balances.
transferFrom reduces the spender allowance.
_spender parameter keys the allowance entry in approve.
_value parameter is stored as the new allowance in approve.
msg.sender is the allowance owner index in approve.
approve writes directly into the allowed mapping.
approve performs the unconditional allowance overwrite flagged as unsafe.
msg.sender scopes the allowance slot that is overwritten without checks.
_owner parameter indexes the allowance lookup in allowance.
_spender parameter indexes the allowance lookup in allowance.
allowance reads from the allowed mapping.
_spender parameter selects the allowance entry in increaseApproval.
_addedValue parameter is added to the current allowance in increaseApproval.
msg.sender indexes the allowance owner in increaseApproval.
increaseApproval reads and writes the allowed mapping.
increaseApproval stores the increased allowance.
_spender parameter selects the allowance entry in decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue parameter reduces the allowance in decreaseApproval.
oldValue local holds the previous allowance read in decreaseApproval.
msg.sender indexes the allowance owner in decreaseApproval.
decreaseApproval reads and writes the allowed mapping.
decreaseApproval stores the reduced allowance.
changeOwner is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
the owner state variable is compared against the caller in the onlyOwner gate.
_newOwner parameter becomes the new owner state.
changeOwner reassigns the privileged owner state variable.
startSale is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
stopSale is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
enableTransfers is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
the constructor assigns ownership to msg.sender.
the constructor writes the owner state variable.
the constructor credits balances[owner] with the initial supply.
the constructor assigns totalSupply from INITIAL_SUPPLY.
the constructor enables transfers globally.
the fallback forwards the caller context into buyTokens.
the fallback function calls buyTokens(msg.sender).
msg.sender is passed as _investor into buyTokens.
_investor parameter determines the mint recipient in buyTokens.
buyTokens calls validPurchaseTokens to compute the token amount.
buyTokens calls mint to allocate tokens.
buyTokens accumulates weiRaised with the paid value.
buyTokens accumulates tokenAllocated with the minted amount.
weiAmount local caches msg.value inside buyTokens.
tokens local holds the computed purchase amount in buyTokens.
the wallet local supplies the recipient of the external ether send.
wallet.transfer(weiAmount) is an external ether call made at the end of buyTokens.
_weiAmount parameter is priced in validPurchaseTokens.
validPurchaseTokens calls getTotalAmountOfTokens for pricing.
addTokens local holds the pricing result in validPurchaseTokens.
validPurchaseTokens compares against balances[owner].
the owner state variable indexes the remaining sale balance.
_weiAmount parameter drives the tiered pricing if-chain.
amountOfTokens local accumulates tiered token amounts.
_to parameter is credited in mint.
_amount parameter is moved between balances in mint.
_owner parameter is debited in mint.
mint reads the balances mapping for source and destination.
mint writes the added and subtracted balances.
startSale sets the saleToken flag to true.
stopSale sets the saleToken flag to false.
enableTransfers writes the transfersEnabled flag.
_transfersEnabled parameter becomes the new flag value.
claimTokens is restricted to msg.sender == owner.
claimTokens reads the owner state for the modifier and the sweep target.
the owner state variable is the destination of the contract ether sweep.
owner.transfer(this.balance) is an external ether call inside claimTokens.
claimTokens calls balanceOf(this) to size the token sweep.
balance local stores balanceOf(this) before the token sweep.
claimTokens calls the ERC20 transfer to move remaining tokens to owner.

_spender is only a lookup key consumed by allowance.
